note: Brief 097: material rows Look097Materials.Apply sets on the kit's generated materials (unity/Assets/Suborned/Kit/Materials, git-ignored) before every game build. wind: material -> the sway's reach in metres (URP Lit's _Parallax slot; negative = weighted by the distance from the piece's axis too, for palms) with _DK_WIND on. vertexAO: name prefixes whose materials take _DK_VERTEX_AO (the baked AO in the vertex colour's R; a mesh without colours reads white = no change). Shaders: DK_Wind097.hlsl, DK_Forward097.hlsl.

cloth.note: Sky 2026-11-07: "I like idea of motion - we have a lot of banners": banners hung between two arms belly in the wind, most at mid-height, the hems fixed on the arms (DK_Wind097.hlsl _DK_WIND_CLOTH; the art's v runs 0 at the bottom hem to 1 at the top). material -> the belly's reach in metres at mid-height. DK_Banner_Comet: the lamp posts' comet banners (the zone's seven lamps, merged, and the old town's 27).

bake.note: ZoneBake097: the baked sky and bounce scaled so the lightmapped zone sits near the unbaked play look's exposure (the flat trilight lit every corner fully; the baked sky is occluded). sky x the play look's ambient intensity; bounce = LightingSettings.indirectScale

interior.note: windows that show a room behind the glass (_DK_INTERIOR, DK_Interior097.hlsl); smoothness is the glass's reflection over the room; rooms off on every pane (Sky 2026-11-06: "a lot of artifacting / flickering ... it's these windows"): the room grid's cells are wider than the Records Office tower's slots and the kit's narrow panes, so they showed random room slices and shimmering blinds; the kit's glass as in 0.2.253

shaders.note: a kit material moved to a brief 097 shader (its texture slots of the same name are kept), with the floats and colours given

DK_GlassDark.note: the zone's glass (the Records Office tower's slot windows, the café): no rooms (Sky 2026-11-06: "a lot of artifacting / flickering ... it's these windows": the tower's slots are narrower than a room cell, so they showed random slices of rooms and shimmering blinds); the film as thick as 0.2.253's (_Edge 0.92, cover 0.65: a thinner film showed the bay's back wall and its shimmering shadow acne), the warm glaze kept

DK_Glass_Sheen.note: the café's painted reflection streaks (cafe_upper.py, two a pane), made when the glass was flat enamel; over GlassSky's own sheen and rooms they read as white scratches (Sky 2026-11-06: "the cafes window look bad"), so they stay only as a faint glint
